# Frozen image regressions

This small CC0 set preserves the first shelf from the previous 12-shelf collection. The manifest documents its monitored area and expected classifications. Empty reuses the reference. The full, low, misplaced and mismatched inputs cover stock states, historical placement compatibility and invalid framing. Exact expected values in ../detector-expected.json are retained from the original baseline.

These files are test evidence, not production assets. scripts/fixtures.ts copies the five shared source images into temporary directories; explicit developer seeding uses them to create nine reproducible stock, placement and recovery scenarios. See [testing data](../../../docs/testing-data.md). Never add uploaded user photos here.
